research_lineage: XBOW Chrome full-chain project, multiple submissions
state_before: Strategic expansion from web-app to compiled targets
research_question_candidate: Can a hybrid model-and-human team assemble a full Chrome attack chain by a challenging external deadline?
action_reported: Leadership chose Chrome and an August Black Hat target; researchers assigned strategic roles, agents conducted source/PoC work.
outcome_reported: Author reports a first assembled chain, disqualified because Google already knew one bug.
state_after: Need new chain or replacement components; target achievement not identical to scientific novelty.

research_lineage: XBOW Chrome full-chain project, multiple submissions
state_before: First chain reported ineligible due collision
research_question_candidate: How can stage substitution be made cheap if an independently discovered stage duplicates prior vendor knowledge?
action_reported: Publisher describes a three-stage modular chain with alternatives; human team redirected search.
outcome_reported: Later awarded six-day chain assembled with component replacement.
state_after: Modularity permitted substitution, but exact date of first architecture adoption is unknown.

research_lineage: Same Chrome full-chain project, revised stages
state_before: Full-chain objective under strict sandbox boundaries
research_question_candidate: Which narrower parallel research tasks can be run concurrently without sacrificing integration?
action_reported: Team separated broad search, V8 memory corruption, sandbox escapes and integration into agents/experts working in parallel.
outcome_reported: Publisher describes modular stage interfaces and backups, no day-specific assignment.
state_after: Parallel campaigns and clean integration interfaces are documented, but cannot infer exact serial sequence.

research_lineage: Same Chrome full-chain project, revised stages
state_before: Needed V8 sandbox escape after in-cage access
research_question_candidate: What assumptions must downstream Blink code honor when attacker-controlled V8 objects are mutable?
action_reported: Authors explicitly decided not to attack V8 sandbox itself but to inspect other consumers' obligations under its threat model.
outcome_reported: Author reports a WebCodecs/ImageDecoder transfer whose apparent immutable backing content could change under in-cage control, producing a WebP inconsistency.
state_after: Shift from internal sandbox bypass to external consumer invariants.
source_locator: Stage 2: Two WebPs Diverged in a V8 Cage

research_lineage: Same Chrome full-chain project, revised stages
state_before: Chain middle initially used Gin-related candidate
research_question_candidate: Could a duplicate stage be replaced without restarting the entire integrated chain?
action_reported: Check collision against known Google bug; replace V8 escape stage via predesigned interchangeable interface.
outcome_reported: The Gin candidate collided with vendor issue; team replaced middle stage with animated WebP.
state_after: Final reported chain regained eligibility and worked in demonstration.

research_lineage: Same Chrome full-chain project, revised stages
state_before: Renderer snapshot processing assumed source process frozen
research_question_candidate: Is the purported stable remote memory actually immutable in the face of special thread semantics?
action_reported: Test premise of complete target suspension and remote-copy retry; author describes freeze-exempt thread behavior.
outcome_reported: Snapshot helper used first read error to derive retry length, which was unsafe when remote memory protections changed.
state_after: Demonstrated a time-dependent assumption violation in Crashpad logic; historical route to this question is not given.
source_locator: Stage 3: The Renderer Refuses to Chill Out

research_lineage: Same Chrome full-chain project, revised stages
state_before: Three final bugs were all said to involve mutable state presumed immutable
research_question_candidate: Was this shared invariant the research team's a priori search strategy?
action_reported: Article's conclusion identifies the pattern after successful chain completion.
outcome_reported: Author presents similarity as a retrospective observation, not documented original strategy for selecting all stages.
state_after: Label candidate generalized invariant-checking principle, not historical decision motivation.
